scanNote:
GRAMMAR 26-BET. Unit 6 nazariyasi + savol so'zlari mashqi.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. Nazariya (10 ta savol so'zi va noto'g'ri ko'plik shakllari) to'g'ri ko'chirilgan. 1-mashqning 20 ta javobi ham TO'G'RI.

⚠ SAVOL SO'ZINI JAVOBDAN TOPISh — MASHQNING KALITI:
  odam nomi ('My sister') → WHO
  joy ('In Antarctica')   → WHERE
  sabab ('Because...')    → WHY
  vaqt nuqtasi ('In my free time') → WHEN
  chastota ('Once a month', 'Every morning') → HOW OFTEN
  davomiylik ('For 15 years', 'Eight hours') → HOW LONG
  sanalmaydigan miqdor ('Not much', 'About 250 kilos') → HOW MUCH
  sanaladigan miqdor ('Only one') → HOW MANY
  usul ('By bus') va o'lcham ('I'm 1.50 m') → HOW
  narsa/rang ('Fish', 'Black') → WHAT

⚠ 'HOW MUCH' IKKI VAZIFADA: pul/miqdor ('How much money?') va OG'IRLIK ('How much do sea lions weigh?'). Ikkinchisi o'zbekchada 'qancha og'irlikda' — boshqacha tuziladi.

⚠ NOTO'G'RI KO'PLIKLAR — ro'yxat to'liq: man-men, woman-women, tooth-teeth, child-children, person-people, foot-feet, mouse-mice, goose-geese, deer-deer, ox-oxen, fish-fish, sheep-sheep.
  ⚠ Oxirgi uchtasi O'ZGARMAYDI (deer, fish, sheep) — 'sheeps' yoki 'fishes' xato (fishes faqat turlar haqida gapirganda).

⚠ 'In Antarctica' — pingvinlar haqidagi soddalashtirish; Coursebook 40-betda ham shu qayd bor (pingvinlarning ko'p turi Antarktidadan tashqarida yashaydi).

sections.title: Theory — Questions and Irregular Plurals
sections.titleUz: Nazariya — So'roq so'zlari va noto'g'ri ko'plik

exercises.instructionEn: Questions with: who, where, why, when, what, how long, how much, how many, how often, how
exercises.instructionUz: So'roq so'zlari: who, where, why, when, what, how long, how much, how many, how often, how
exercises.explanationUz:
O'NTA SO'ROQ SO'ZI VA ULARNING VAZIFASI:

  WHO ......... kim?              — odam
  WHERE ....... qayerda?          — joy
  WHY ......... nega?             — sabab (javob: Because ...)
  WHEN ........ qachon?           — vaqt
  WHAT ........ nima?             — narsa, hayvon, ish
  HOW LONG .... qancha vaqt?      — davomiylik
                qancha uzun?      — uzunlik
  HOW MUCH .... qancha?           — og'irlik, narx, SANALMAYDIGAN miqdor
  HOW MANY .... nechta?           — SANALADIGAN miqdor
  HOW OFTEN ... qanchalik tez-tez? — chastota
  HOW ......... qanday?           — usul, yo'l

SAVOL TUZILISHI:
  So'roq so'zi + DO/DOES + ega + fe'l (asos shakli)?
     Where DO kangaroos LIVE?
     How often DOES a dog EAT?

  'be', 'can', 'have got' bilan DO/DOES KERAK EMAS:
     Who IS Michael?
     What CAN a sea lion do?
     How many legs HAS a lion GOT?

points.en: Who is Michael? — He's my brother.
Where do kangaroos live? — They live in Australia.
points.uz: Kengurular qayerda yashaydi? — Ular Avstraliyada yashaydi.

points.en: Why do dolphins learn easily? — Because they're intelligent.
points.uz: Nega delfinlar oson o'rganadi? — Chunki ular aqlli.

points.en: When do tigers sleep? — They sleep during the day.
points.uz: Yo'lbarslar qachon uxlaydi? — Ular kunduzi uxlaydi.

points.en: What do koalas eat? — They eat eucalyptus leaves.
points.uz: Koalalar nima yeydi? — Ular evkalipt bargini yeydi.

points.en: How long do sea lions live? — They live for about 15 years.
points.uz: Dengiz sherlari qancha yashaydi? — Ular taxminan 15 yil yashaydi.

points.en: How much does an elephant weigh? — About 4,000 kilos.
points.noteUz: 'How much' — og'irlik. Birlik ega → DOES + weigh (-s YO'Q).

points.en: How many legs has a lion got? — A lion has got four legs.
points.uz: Sherning nechta oyog'i bor? — Sherning to'rtta oyog'i bor.
points.noteUz: 'How many' — sanaladigan. 'has ... got' bilan 'does' kerak emas.

points.en: How often does a dog eat? — Twice a day.
points.uz: It qanchalik tez-tez ovqatlanadi? — Kuniga ikki marta.
points.noteUz: 'How often' — chastota. 'twice a day' = kuniga ikki marta.

points.en: How do kangaroos carry their babies? — In a pouch.
points.uz: Kengurular bolalarini qanday olib yuradi? — Xaltada.

exercises.instructionEn: Irregular Plurals. Some nouns have irregular plural forms.
exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri ko'plik. Ba'zi otlarning ko'plik shakli qoidaga bo'ysunmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI GURUH:

  1) O'ZAK O'ZGARADI
       man    → men       (erkak)
       woman  → women     (ayol)
       tooth  → teeth     (tish)
       child  → children  (bola)
       person → people    (shaxs)
       foot   → feet      (oyoq kafti)
       mouse  → mice      (sichqon)
       goose  → geese     (g'oz)
       ox     → oxen      (ho'kiz)

  2) SHAKL O'ZGARMAYDI
       deer  → deer   (kiyik)
       fish  → fish   (baliq)
       sheep → sheep  (qo'y)

DIQQAT: bularning hech biriga -S QO'SHILMAYDI.
'mans', 'childs', 'mouses', 'sheeps', 'fishs' — HAMMASI XATO.

points.noteUz: Yozilishida ikkinchi bo'g'in, talaffuzida BIRINCHI bo'g'in o'zgaradi: /ˈwʊmən/ → /ˈwɪmɪn/.
Butunlay boshqa so'z. 'people' DOIM ko'plik: people ARE.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in what, who, how many, how long, when, where, why, how much, how often or how.
exercises.instructionUz: what, who, how many, how long, when, where, why, how much, how often yoki how so'zlarini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
USUL: JAVOBGA QARANG, so'ng savolni tanlang.

  Javob odam           → WHO
  Javob joy            → WHERE
  Javob vaqt           → WHEN
  Javob 'Because ...'  → WHY
  Javob narsa/ish      → WHAT
  Javob 'once/twice/every ...' → HOW OFTEN
  Javob yil/soat (davomiylik)  → HOW LONG
  Javob kilo/pul (sanalmaydi)  → HOW MUCH
  Javob son (sanaladi)         → HOW MANY
  Javob usul (By bus)          → HOW

items.textEn: 1  A: "............ do dolphins eat?"  B: "They eat fish."
items.whyUz: Javob 'fish' (narsa) → WHAT.

items.textEn: 2  A: "............ do penguins live?"  B: "In Antarctica."
items.whyUz: Javob 'In Antarctica' (joy) → WHERE.

items.textEn: 3  A: "............ do you play football?"  B: "In my free time."
items.whyUz: 'In my free time' = bo'sh vaqtimda — bu VAQT → WHEN.

items.textEn: 4  A: "............ do you visit your grandparents?"  B: "Once a month."
items.whyUz: 'Once a month' = oyiga bir marta — bu CHASTOTA → HOW OFTEN.

items.textEn: 5  A: "............ is that girl over there?"  B: "My sister."
items.whyUz: 'My sister' (odam) → WHO. 'be' bilan 'does' kerak emas.

items.textEn: 6  A: "............ do kangaroos have strong back legs?"  B: "Because they need to jump very high."
items.whyUz: Javob 'Because ...' → WHY. Bu eng aniq belgi.

items.textEn: 7  A: "............ do koalas sleep?"  B: "In the tops of eucalyptus trees."
items.whyUz:
'In the tops of eucalyptus trees' (joy) → WHERE.
DIQQAT: 'When do koalas sleep?' savoliga 'during the day' javob bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 8  A: "............ money do you have?"  B: "Not much."
items.whyUz:
'money' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → HOW MUCH.
Javob ham 'Not much' — bu ham sanalmaydigan miqdor.

items.textEn: 9  A: "............ can a sea lion do?"  B: "It can swim very well."
items.whyUz: Javob ISH (swim) → WHAT. 'can' bilan 'does' kerak emas.

items.textEn: 10  A: "............ are you smiling?"  B: "Because I'm happy."
items.whyUz:
Javob 'Because I'm happy' → WHY.
'to smile' = tabassum qilmoq (40-betdagi 'a smile' — ot).

items.textEn: 11  A: "............ do you feed your goldfish?"  B: "Every morning."
items.whyUz:
'Every morning' = har ertalab — bu CHASTOTA → HOW OFTEN.
'a goldfish' = tilla baliq.

items.textEn: 12  A: "............ do tigers live?"  B: "For about fifteen years."
items.whyUz: 'For about fifteen years' — DAVOMIYLIK → HOW LONG.

items.textEn: 13  A: "............ is Mrs Jackson?"  B: "Our neighbour."
items.whyUz:
'Our neighbour' (odam) → WHO.
'a neighbour' = qo'shni (britancha yozilishi; amerikacha: neighbor).

items.textEn: 14  A: "............ colour is your cat?"  B: "Black."
items.whyUz: 'What colour ...?' = qanday rangda? — o'zgarmas ibora (44-bet).

items.textEn: 15  A: "............ pieces of pie do you want?"  B: "Only one, please."
items.whyUz:
'pieces' — SANALADIGAN ot → HOW MANY. Javob ham son: 'Only one'.
'a piece of pie' = bir bo'lak pirog.
'How + sifat' — o'lchov savoli: How TALL are you? (44-betdagi 'How big is it?' kabi).

items.textEn: 17  A: "............ do sea lions weigh?"  B: "About 250 kilos."
items.whyUz: Og'irlik → HOW MUCH. 45-betdagi dengiz sheri ma'lumoti bilan bir xil.

items.textEn: 18  A: "............ do you get to school?"  B: "By bus."
items.whyUz:
'By bus' — USUL → yolg'iz HOW.
'get to' = yetib bormoq. Transport: BY bus/car/train (artiklsiz).

items.textEn: 19  A: "............ do you sleep at night?"  B: "Eight hours."
items.whyUz:
'Eight hours' — DAVOMIYLIK → HOW LONG.
DIQQAT: 'How often' bo'lsa javob 'every night' bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 20  A: "............ is Ankara?"  B: "In Turkey."
items.whyUz: 'In Turkey' (joy) → WHERE. Ankara — Turkiya poytaxti.

wordFormation.introUz: 26-bet — so'roq so'zlari va noto'g'ri ko'plik shakllari.

groups.explanationUz: 'How' yolg'iz USUL so'raydi; boshqa so'z qo'shilsa ma'nosi o'zgaradi.

items.derived: How do you get to school?

groups.explanationUz: 'a' bu yerda 'har' degani: a day = kuniga.
Bu farq how much / how many tanlashda hal qiluvchi.

patterns.formula: So'roq so'zi + DO/DOES + ega + fe'l (asos shakli)?
patterns.exampleEn: Where do kangaroos live? How often does a dog eat?
patterns.exampleUz: Kengurular qayerda yashaydi? It qanchalik tez-tez ovqatlanadi?
patterns.explanationUz:
Ko'plik va I/you/we/they → DO.
Birlik (he/she/it, a dog) → DOES.
'does' bor bo'lsa asosiy fe'lga -s QO'SHILMAYDI.

patterns.exampleEn: Who is Michael? Where is Ankara? How tall are you?
patterns.exampleUz: Maykl kim? Anqara qayerda? Bo'yingiz qancha?
patterns.explanationUz: 'be' fe'li o'zi egadan oldinga chiqadi — DO/DOES kerak emas.

patterns.exampleEn: What can a sea lion do?

patterns.formula: HOW MANY + ot + HAS/HAVE + ega + GOT?
patterns.exampleEn: How many legs has a lion got?
patterns.explanationUz: 'have got' bilan ham DO/DOES kerak emas.

patterns.exampleEn: Why are you smiling? — Because I'm happy.
patterns.exampleUz: Nega tabassum qilyapsiz? — Chunki men baxtliman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'Because' dan keyin ega va fe'l bo'lgan to'liq gap keladi.

patterns.formula: WHAT + ot + is/are ...? (what colour, what kind, what size)
patterns.exampleEn: What colour is your cat? — Black.
patterns.explanationUz: 'What' otga birikib, o'sha ot bo'yicha savol beradi.
